build.buildCommand: cd backend3 && npm install && npx prisma generate && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: cd backend3 && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && npx ts-node prisma/migrate-old-data.ts && npx ts-node prisma/seed.ts && NODE_ENV=production node dist/index.js
